name: Qwen3-Embedding
usage: Text embeddings (search, retrieval, memory for assistants)

licence.note: Apache 2.0 (on HF; no licence in the Ollama manifest)

parameters_total_b.note: 8B, the size of the default Ollama tag

runtimes.value: Ollama official qwen3-embedding; llama.cpp llama-server --embedding --pooling last (official Qwen GGUF); sentence-transformers >= 2.7 (transformers >= 4.51) on MPS; MLX via mlx-community builds (0.6B/4B/8B, 4bit-DWQ, mxfp8); TEI and vLLM >= 0.8.5 documented (CUDA/CPU)
runtimes.note: MPS for sentence-transformers is the usual PyTorch path; no first-hand report found. The MLX package used by the mlx-community builds (mlx-embeddings presumably) not confirmed on the card. A 2025 GGUF issue required adding the EOS token manually (llama.cpp #14234); current status not checked.

web.scope: Searched on 13.11.2026. Sources: Hacker News comments, Hugging Face discussions, Ollama, llama.cpp and mlx-lm issues. **Reddit could not be read** (blocked for automated reading); summaries of Reddit threads by other sites were not used as evidence. Released 03.06.2025; window: since 13.05.2026. **Feedback very thin.**
web.verdict: Still the reference, no successor; very thin feedback

comments.text: 8B gives NaN vectors in FP16 for some texts; BF16 fixes it; not seen on macOS ([HF #21](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-8B/discussions/21), before the window).
Vectors change between runtime versions: pin the runtime or re-embed everything ([HF 0.6B #60, 12.06.2026](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B/discussions/60)).
Still the usual choice for local search and RAG; 32K context ([donhardman, 17.09.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49739903)). No newer Qwen text-embedding family.
